schemes.name: National Merit Scholarship
schemes.description: Financial assistance for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to pursue higher education at premier institutions.
schemes.eligibility: Students scoring 80%+ in Class 12 with family income below ₹6 LPA

schemes.name: Pradhan Swasthya Yojana
schemes.description: Comprehensive health coverage providing cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals for all government scheme beneficiaries.
schemes.eligibility: BPL families and low-income households across all states

schemes.name: Kisan Samridhi Scheme
schemes.description: Direct income support and crop insurance for small and marginal farmers to ensure agricultural sustainability.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land upto 2 hectares

schemes.name: Grih Laxmi Housing Scheme
schemes.description: Subsidized home loans and construction assistance for low-income families to own their first residential property.
schemes.eligibility: First-time home buyers with income below ₹12 LPA

schemes.name: Nari Shakti Udyog Yojana
schemes.description: Financial support, training, and mentorship for women entrepreneurs to start and scale their small businesses.
schemes.eligibility: Women aged 18-55 with a viable business plan

schemes.name: Vayo Vandana Pension
schemes.description: Monthly pension scheme providing financial security and healthcare benefits to senior citizens above 60 years.
schemes.eligibility: Citizens aged 60+ with no other pension source
